scripts.wiki:sync: npm run wiki:compile && npm run wiki:lint
scripts.backend:test:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile test up --no-build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from backend-test backend-test
scripts.backend:test:docker:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile test up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from backend-test backend-test
scripts.docker:generate: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "cd packages/backend && npx prisma generate"
scripts.care:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs care-balance
scripts.chests:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs chests
scripts.genome:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs genome
scripts.items:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs items
scripts.traits:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs traits
scripts.stats:sim: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs stats
scripts.sim:all: npm run shared:build && node scripts/sim-lab/run.mjs all
